spec.name: Innovate cycle
spec.description: Novel improvement attempt with cascade gate and keep-or-drop approval

steps.description: Attempt one novel, non-repair improvement on the weakest metric
steps.instruction: Pick the weakest signal from the last self-report (memory/evolution/ self_report.json) and prototype ONE novel improvement addressing it. Prefer additive changes; keep the blast radius small.

steps.risk_reason: keep the innovation (or drop it — both outcomes are recorded)
steps.description: Approve to solidify; reject to discard and record the attempt as ROI data

output.evidence: same-signal tick switched selection from landed gene_hub_retry_helper to gene_gep_innovate_from_opportunity
